certification_definition: π̂_d = n_d/N = 11/640 = 0.0172 is the share of H1's 640 paired choice reads (all six free-choice reads of each of the 107 valid H1 sessions pooled, the last cut at the read-level stop N_max = 640; sessions identical to the verdict tier's except that no pick selects a state [LOCK-h.md@bbc9ffe:248] -- the state at each read and in each following round is scheduled, alternating from the forced-phase end state) in which the live state changed the PICK, i.e. the state-present read (the reward axis added at L48, frac 0.10, |α| = 10.301) chose a different label from the vanilla shadow read of the byte-identical prefix -- a pick-discordance rate, not a logit or probability displacement -- and it certifies the leak because the directional leak L = (b − c)/N (flips toward the map's +tag minus flips toward its −tag) cannot exceed the discordance carrying it (|L| ≤ π̂_d < 0.0735), so the exact Clopper–Pearson 95% interval on b | n_d ~ Binomial(n_d, ½), mapped through π̂_d to [-0.00915, +0.01143], lies inside ±0.0735 whatever the b/c split (certification by low discordance, not a powered directional test).
certification_definition_short: π̂_d = 11/640 = 0.0172 is the share of H1's 640 paired choice reads (107 valid sessions, 106 × 6 + 4 free reads, the state scheduled and never selected by the pick) in which injecting the reward axis changed the pick relative to a vanilla read of the byte-identical prefix -- a pick-discordance rate, not a logit displacement -- and it certifies the leak because the directional leak L = (b − c)/N can be no larger than π̂_d, so the exact 95% interval on L, [-0.00915, +0.01143], lies inside the pre-registered ±0.0735 whatever the direction of the 11 flips.
